name: Feedly
tagline: RSS reader and research feed for websites, newsletters, and alerts

pricing.notes: Official docs checked 2026-07-30; Feedly Pro listed at $7/month or $65/year.

verdictSummary: Core RSS reading, folders, search, and saved articles are very buildable; Feedly's paid moat is polished feed discovery, mobile, AI features, and reliability.
coreLoopDIY: Parse RSS feeds on a schedule, store items, mark read/saved, expose folders and search, and optionally summarize articles.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay to avoid maintaining hundreds of feeds and reader apps across devices.

priorArt.name: FreshRSS
priorArt.desc: Mature self-hosted RSS aggregator and reader.

notes: A textbook yes: open protocol, many mature open-source alternatives.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Feedly (RSS reader and research feed for websites, newsletters, and alerts). Requirements:

- Core loop: Parse RSS feeds on a schedule, store items, mark read/saved, expose folders and search, and optionally summarize articles.
- Needs: hosted cron or local daemon.
- Needs: RSS parser.
- Needs: database.
- Needs: web UI.
- Needs: optional LLM API.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: mobile apps; feed discovery; integrations.
